summary: Stair-access tower of 100 ft dated 1969; auctioned spring 2012 and now listed as private property not open to the public.

facts.design: Stair-access tower with a square cab
facts.status_note: County list says the tower stands; the list is undated. It was auctioned in spring 2012 and is most likely private property now.
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service (listed owner; footnote gives the Minnesota DNR Forestry Division as its current name)

access.note: County list names a private owner and a footnote says the tower is not accessible to the public.

events.note: County list gives 1969 in its date column; the Commons description says built in 1969.
Tower auctioned in spring 2012, per the county list.

evidence.supports: Lawson record: date 1969, height 100, stair type
Built in 1969 and named for a state forester (Commons description)
evidence.quote: Built in 1969 it was named for a prominent state forester.
auctioned Spring 2012. Square cab. Most likely private

evidence.supports: One of the last fire towers erected in Minnesota (Commons description)
evidence.quote: One of the last fire towers erected in Minnesota.

evidence.quote: Owned by private party and not accessible to public

notes_for_editor: Two sources only: the county PDF and the Commons file page. Wikidata gives no dates. Lawson is not on the Forest Fire Lookout Association Minnesota list. No construction, staffing or fire history found, so the story leaves those out. The county list is undated, so standing is as of an unknown date. Brief status unknown updated to standing; access set to private. Photo caption is the uploader's own text.
